tldr: North Node in House 8: growth through shared resources, trust, intimacy, grief work, and honest exchange.
body: This nodal axis asks the person to develop shared resources, trust, intimacy, grief work, and honest exchange. The South Node in House 2 shows the familiar life field: self-protection through possessions, certainty, or keeping everything separate. The house axis describes where the growth has to become lived, not just understood. The practice is to learn which bonds are safe enough for depth.
business: Growth becomes practical when the person chooses shared resources, trust, intimacy, grief work, and honest exchange in the concrete house topics of daily life.
shadow: Under stress, the South Node in House 2 can pull the person back toward self-protection through possessions, certainty, or keeping everything separate.
policy: Read as a nodal axis: North Node house names the growth field; South Node house names the familiar field. Requires accurate birth time for house placement.
note: Distilled from approved project node source material. Source files were not copied into the repository.
